messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and throttles observed on /v1/stream/completions in us-west-2. Paging oncall @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it — creating incident thread. Quick triage: ~12% error rate for streaming, p50 latency spike. Noted 4 customer-facing failures (3 are high-fanout integrations).

bob_sre: Can we apply temporary soft-quotas to noisy tokens and flip streaming->non-streaming fallback for heavy customers? Also consider early 429 shaping.

carla_sdk: SDK heads-up: disabling streaming will change client behavior. We can cut a hotfix to tighten retry/backoff + idempotency support — ETA ~30m.

alice_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) soft-quota top offenders 2) toggle streaming-disable flag for impacted tokens 3) enable model-fallback to smaller variant for degraded paths. Starting step 1 now.

system: Config change: soft-quota applied to 7 customer tokens (cfg-2799) by alice_oncall.

dave_prod: Routing update: rolling canary to fallback model small-gen-v2 for 2% traffic now, will scale if metrics look good.

eve_support: CS sending templated customer notice about mitigations and suggested client changes. Notifying affected accounts (list sent in ticket).

carla_sdk: Client guidance to share with customers: reduce retries to max 3, implement exponential backoff with full jitter, attach idempotency keys for retryable requests, and avoid streaming until stable. Sample JS snippet to suggest: ```js
// exponential backoff with jitter
async function backoff(attempt){
  const base = 200; // ms
  const cap = 5000;
  const exp = Math.min(cap, base * 2**attempt);
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * exp);
}
```

frank_cs: Customer-impact summary: 4 customers impacted (2 enterprise, redacted). Degradation window so far: 12:05 - 12:28 UTC. Most errors are during streaming handshake/keepalive.

bob_sre: Server-side recommendation: enable circuit-breaker to emit 429+Retry-After for tokens with >20% 5xx over 2m, add telemetry tag `live-mitigation=enabled`, and increase logging for stream timeouts.

alice_oncall: :white_check_mark: Actions taken: soft-quotas applied, streaming flag toggled for 3 tokens, canary fallback live. Carla — please publish SDK hotfix with remote opt-in flag so customers can opt into safer behavior without breaking. Monitoring closely.

carla_sdk: :information_source: Hotfix published as npm v1.2.3-hotfix. Remote opt-in flag: `disableStreamingOnError`. PR with docs: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/456

incident-bot: Incident update: observed error rate down to ~2.1%, latencies converging. Last check 12:36 UTC. Oncall: @alice_oncall for next steps.
